name: Neha Vertika

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Neha Vertika is a poet and story writer from Lucknow whose writing has continued while living in Switzerland. A management graduate with experience in teaching and soft-skills training, she contributes to magazines and digital literary platforms. A 2022 WomenShine profile describes her return to public poetry through writing about Lucknow and participating in online readings.

In her Kabita Live poem ‘कुछ सामान अनोखे लायी हूँ’, the language of shopping becomes a playful way to gather the natural world. Dreams arrive by the sack, darkness by weight, and sunlight in kilowatts. These impossible purchases become gifts for the home and its relationships, ending with a delivery of hope and smiles.
